obligations.subject: Skill package frontmatter validator
obligations.trigger: A Skill package is submitted for validation.
obligations.observable_result: The validator produces a validation result for the frontmatter.

obligations.subject: Skill package frontmatter
obligations.trigger: A Skill package is submitted for validation.
obligations.state_after: Validation rejects the package when frontmatter is missing.
obligations.observable_result: A missing-frontmatter validation failure is reported.
forbidden_result: A package with missing frontmatter is accepted.

obligations.subject: Skill package frontmatter
obligations.trigger: A Skill package is submitted for validation.
obligations.state_before: Frontmatter may be syntactically or structurally malformed.
obligations.state_after: Validation rejects the package when frontmatter is malformed.
obligations.observable_result: A malformed-frontmatter validation failure is reported.

obligations.subject: Skill frontmatter name
obligations.state_before: The name field may be empty.
obligations.state_after: Validation accepts only a nonempty name.
obligations.observable_result: An empty name produces a validation failure; a nonempty name passes this check.

obligations.subject: Skill frontmatter description
obligations.state_before: The description field may be empty.
obligations.state_after: Validation accepts only a nonempty description.
obligations.observable_result: An empty description produces a validation failure; a nonempty description passes this check.

obligations.subject: Skill package name
obligations.state_before: The package name may be noncanonical.
obligations.state_after: Validation accepts only the canonical package name.
obligations.expected_behavior: Validate that the package name is canonical.
obligations.observable_result: A noncanonical package name produces a validation failure.
forbidden_result: A noncanonical package name is accepted.

obligations.subject: Declared Skill identity and package name
obligations.state_before: The package name and declared Skill identity may conflict.
obligations.state_after: Validation accepts only consistent identity and package naming.
obligations.expected_behavior: Validate consistency between the canonical package name and the declared Skill identity.
obligations.observable_result: A conflicting name and Skill identity produce a validation failure.
forbidden_result: Conflicting package and Skill identity names are accepted.

obligations.subject: Frontmatter keys
obligations.state_after: Validation rejects frontmatter containing duplicate keys.
obligations.observable_result: A duplicate-key validation failure is reported.
forbidden_result: Duplicate keys overwrite earlier values without rejection.

obligations.subject: Frontmatter name declarations
obligations.state_before: Frontmatter may contain conflicting name declarations.
obligations.expected_behavior: Treat a conflicting name as invalid.
obligations.observable_result: A conflicting-name validation failure is reported.

obligations.subject: Frontmatter extensions
obligations.expected_behavior: Treat unsupported frontmatter extensions as invalid.
obligations.observable_result: An unsupported-extension validation failure is reported.

obligations.subject: Frontmatter parser
obligations.state_before: Untrusted frontmatter input is available for parsing.
obligations.state_after: Parsing completes without executing YAML or object constructors.
obligations.expected_behavior: Parse frontmatter safely using non-executing parsing behavior.
obligations.observable_result: The parsed result contains data only and no constructor execution occurs.
forbidden_result: Parsing evaluates executable payloads embedded in frontmatter.

obligations.subject: YAML and object constructors
obligations.state_before: The parser may expose YAML or object-constructor execution paths.
obligations.state_after: Constructor execution remains disabled throughout parsing.
obligations.expected_behavior: Never execute YAML or object constructors.
obligations.observable_result: Constructor-based payloads are not executed during parsing.
